key_concepts: Major organs work together to make the body function properly.
The heart is a hollow muscular organ that pumps blood throughout the body.
The brain processes information and sends instructions to body parts.
The kidneys filter wastes from blood and remove them as urine.
The lungs filter inhaled oxygen and remove carbon dioxide during breathing.
Bones form a framework that supports, shapes, and protects the body.
Muscles, joints, and tendons work with bones to enable movement.
The stomach stores and softens food and begins digestion.
The small intestine completes digestion and absorbs nutrients.
The large intestine absorbs water and forms feces for elimination.
The rib cage protects the heart and lungs, and the skull protects the brain.
